program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to context-gated prediction
question: Can the supported ambiguity concentration result be converted into a fixed-capacity selector that uses exact pair context only where training-side ambiguity indicates it is useful?
hypothesis: Reconstruct the sealed current-only predictor and top-511 exact-pair predictor. For each heldout triple, use exact-pair prediction only when the pair is dedicated, its training support is at least three, the current row has at least four training transitions, and its training-side top1-minus-top2 probability margin is at or below the frozen median ambiguity cutoff. Otherwise use current-only prediction. The hybrid will improve pooled top-1 accuracy by at least 0.005 over current-only, outperform the sealed support>=3 backoff selector by at least 0.002 pooled, and degrade no source by more than 0.005 versus current-only.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: Exact context is useful when current-state prediction is ambiguous and sufficiently supported, but slightly harmful on confident rows.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.exact_pair_predictor: byte-identical top-511 exact-pair contexts plus overflow
frozen_reuse.ambiguity_cutoff: byte-identical training-only median-margin rule from signal attribution R1

selector.use_exact_context: dedicated pair AND pair support >=3 AND current-row count >=4 AND current-row training margin <= training median margin

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and frozen gain/nondegradation thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and the ambiguity gate improves pooled accuracy over current-only but misses another frozen threshold.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but ambiguity gating fails to improve pooled current-only accuracy.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, representation, predictor, ambiguity-rule, support-rule, capacity, determinism, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and manifest.
All predictors, support counts, and ambiguity margins are reconstructed from training prefixes only.
Selector rule is frozen before heldout scoring and never updated.
No new predictive state is added; the hybrid chooses only between existing frozen predictors.
Full Go regression passes before probe; duplicate probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, top-511 map, pair-support threshold, ambiguity formula/cutoff, selector, controls, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: carry the supported ambiguity gate into depth-two/depth-three probability-mass composition without increasing state capacity

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: test longer sequence state if the one-step selector does not transfer cleanly
